content: Between the sky and the earth, the millstones of time grind incessantly; rare is the grain that clings to the central pivot and survives unbroken.
author: Kabir
explanation: The grinding wheels of worldly change crush everything on the periphery. But the grain that stays anchored close to the central axle remains completely safe and whole.
practicalInsight: When outer circumstances become chaotic today, return attention to your still inner center. Do not spin on the outer rim.
reflectionPrompt: Am I living on the chaotic perimeter or anchored at the calm center of my being?
